question: Tantia Tope was the general of whom among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nana Saheb**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Tantia Tope** was one of the prominent leaders of the Indian Rebellion of **1857**.

• He served as the **general** of **Nana Saheb**, who was a key figure in the uprising against British rule.

• Tantia Tope's military leadership was instrumental in several battles during the rebellion, including the famous defense of **Cawnpore (Kanpur)** under Nana Saheb's leadership.

• He was known for his guerrilla warfare tactics and played a pivotal role in organizing troops to fight against the British forces.
